I will verify every row and deliver an editable .docx with one revision included. I can start immediately and provide the first formatted sample within two hours. Please confirm the number of worksheets/tables and your preferred page orientation and heading style.

experiments.proposalDraft: Hello, I can build the single-source dashboard for the full ₹20,000 in 7 days, using React or Streamlit depending on the API you choose. I will connect only one source (Stripe, Shopify, YouTube Analytics, or one CRM), keep its credential server-side in an environment variable, and show about five relevant headline metrics plus the last 30 days of daily data. Milestone 1 (₹8,000): working API connection, chart, and headline numbers. Milestone 2 (₹12,000): date-range filter, daily table, responsive laptop layout, tested refresh flow, and a short run/handover guide. I will not add ads, extra sources, accounts, or mobile apps. Please confirm the selected API and which five metrics you want before work begins; credentials can be provided securely after award.
